THE BRAND:

IONH' skincare solutions excel in a comprehensive understanding of atomic molecular behavior of both ingredients and skin cells. Experience a perfectly harmonized interplay between different charges of actives and your skin. 

  • NANO DELIVERY SYSTEM
  • IONIC PRESCISION

Our formulas are a sophisticated blend of clinically backed high-tech bioactive and nano delivery systems to not just to care for the skin but to enlighten it, molecule by molecule.


THE PRODUCT:

Potent multidimensional hydro matrix filler, encapsulating a scientifically advanced matrix of 4D multiweight, with cross-linked and hydrolyzed hyaluronic technologies.

The formula additionally incorporates a high-tech delivery system of nano encapsulated pure Swiss glacier mineral water  in as little as 20 nm in size, Lipobelle™ Glacier, and a novel form of advanced Vitamin C, developed in Japan, integrated into the formula enhancing penetration capabilities. This form is effective in fading dark spots, delivering hydration and antioxidants to the skin.

The serum is designed to deliver advanced full-spectrum hydration for up to 24 hours.

The formulation actively smoothes and plumps the skin, and reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. The benefits extend to help improve the appearance of skin elasticity, even out the complexion, diminish the appearance of dark spots, and deliver bioavailable nutrients directly to the skin's surface.

YOUR BENEFITS:

You will get 10% commission when a customer makes a purchase through your affiliate link or use your coupon code.

Additional benefits and rewards:

• Free gifts/ Samples: We provide a package of our product to new affiliates that have over 10K audience

• Cash bonus: for every month you sell over $3000 in total sales we offer you an extra $100 bonus.
